title: Steam Gaming Time and Backlog Tracker
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steam:player
| stats latest(playtime_forever_min) as total_min, latest(playtime_2weeks_min) as recent_min by game_name
| eval total_hours=round(total_min/60,1), never_played=if(total_min=0,"backlog","played")
| sort - total_hours
description: Tracks how long you have spent in each game and flags the ever-growing backlog of titles you own but have never launched.
value: The gaming backlog is a beloved running joke; quantifying it (and your actual playtime) helps you buy less and play more.
implementation: Ingest Steam owned-games and playtime; schedule weekly and review your playtime and backlog.
visualization: Table of games by total hours with a backlog flag.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how long you have played each game and how many you bought but never actually started.
